mechanism: Darunavir (ritonavir-boosted protease inhibitor) may increase gentamicin nephrotoxicity through renal tubular damage and reduced clearance, while gentamicin's aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity is potentiated by protease inhibitor-associated renal stress.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and gentamicin levels closely; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and use shortest effective duration of gentamicin.
